decisions.reason: Because the two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core coating and application know-how, its strong in-house R&D and customization capabilities make it likely to refine rather than withdraw the product.

The low-pressure injection pump is very close to the firm's established injection and material-processing business, so management would view early market feedback as highly actionable and the product as worth retaining.

As a material transfer pump, this product fits directly with the firm's existing conveying and system-integration knowledge, which supports continued improvement and commercialization instead of exit.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent than the other launches but still builds on the firm's process-equipment base and strategic push toward more digital, interoperable customer solutions, so it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
